description: Use this to remove one inbox rule and its auto-reply cooldown rows. Requires auth and message_update. Inputs: inbox_id (required), rule_id (required). Returns {id, deleted:true}. An unknown rule is HTTP 404 rule_not_found. Another account's inbox is HTTP 404 inbox_not_found.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address owned by this key

name: cooper_delete_rule
title: Delete inbox rule
